description: Washington has become a place where too many politicians serve themselves instead of the people. We need real reforms to restore trust and protect our democracy.My priorities include:Enact term limits for members of Congress and the judiciary branchEstablish mandatory retirement age for the president, members of Congress, and the judiciary Ban stock trading by members of CongressOverturn Citizens United and end dark money in politics
